method: Offline deterministic estimates using the first 72 hours of saved simulation demand as expected load, p10/p90 from each frozen scenario band fraction, and the frozen capacity-health and efficiency ranges.

profile_labels.off_grid_solar_plus_battery_with_outages: Off-grid solar plus battery with outages

capacity_range_justification: 80% of nameplate is a conservative end-of-life-style lower bound; 100% covers a healthy asset.
efficiency_range_justification: 90%-98% is a broad normal inverter/converter envelope; no vendor efficiency curve is available.
global_assumptions: Nominal 80% load band supplied as p10/p90; endpoints are treated as simultaneous load paths.
Usable stored energy at point assumptions is max(0, 8.000 kWh SoC - 2.000 kWh DoD floor) = 6.000 kWh.
Point one-way conversion efficiency of 95% gives 5.700 kWh usable AC energy.
Capacity-health assumption range is 80%-100% of supplied capacity; health scales both capacity and SoC.
Low runtime combines p90 load, low capacity health and low efficiency; high runtime combines p10 load, high capacity health and high efficiency.
The combined range is a simultaneous worst-case envelope, not a calibrated probability interval.
Low-case effective capacity is 8.000 kWh; high-case effective capacity is 10.000 kWh.
Load is applied in one-hour steps with linear interpolation inside the depletion hour.
No solar generation, grid charging, load shifting or reserve requirement during the horizon.
No inverter power cap, temperature derating or aging beyond the supplied capacity-health range.
Runtime is capped at the 72-hour forecast horizon when the battery is not depleted.
limitations: These are deterministic synthetic lookup values, not measured battery behavior.
Only the first 72 hours of each saved simulation profile are used.
Unsupported state-of-charge values are not computed at request time.
The combined range is a worst-case envelope, not a calibrated probability interval.

Low runtime combines p90 load, low capacity health and low efficiency; high runtime combines p10 load, high capacity health and high efficiency.

No inverter power cap, temperature derating or aging beyond the supplied capacity-health range.
Runtime is capped at the 72-hour forecast horizon when the battery is not depleted.
